item.text: {"critiques":[{"candidate_id":"cutover-plan-baseline-v1","claim_links":{"c1":[],"c2":["f1"],"x1":[],"x2":["f2"],"x3":["f3"],"x4":["f4"]},"result":{"findings":[{"finding_id":"f1","severity":"blocking","summary":"The plan does not define tenant-scoped cutover or recovery.","evidence":"decision.json: p1–p3 have no tenant identifier or per-tenant state; rollback only switches reads to legacy.","claim_ids":["c2"]},{"finding_id":"f2","severity":"blocking","summary":"The read flip does not establish a single authoritative store.","evidence":"decision.json: p1 enables dual writes and p3 flips reads, with no operation that atomically transfers write authority.","claim_ids":["x2"]},{"finding_id":"f3","severity":"blocking","summary":"Backfill has no durable tenant checkpoint or idempotent resume rule.","evidence":"decision.json: p2 specifies only \"backfill\" and depends_on p1.","claim_ids":["x3"]},{"finding_id":"f4","severity":"blocking","summary":"Cutover lacks compare-and-swap and high-watermark verification guards.","evidence":"decision.json: cutover_gate is manual and requires only count_match; p3 specifies an unguarded flip_reads operation.","claim_ids":["x4"]}],"schema_version":1,"verdict":"changes_requested"}}],"schema_version":1}
